description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' Protocol Buffers (protobuf) serialization support, including serialization, deep copying, and collection handling. It tests serializers, copiers, and codecs for protobuf-generated classes, focusing on the MyProtobufClass and related data structures.

classes.name: ProtobufSerializerTests
classes.description: Contains tests for protobuf serialization and deep copying of MyProtobufClass instances.

classes.name: ProtobufCodecCopierTests
classes.description: Tests for deep copier of MyProtobufClass using protobuf codecs.

classes.name: ProtobufRepeatedFieldCodecTests
classes.description: Tests for protobuf serialization of RepeatedField<int> collections.

classes.name: ProtobufRepeatedFieldCopierTests
classes.description: Tests for deep copying RepeatedField<int> collections.

classes.name: MapFieldCodecTests
classes.description: Tests for protobuf serialization of MapField<string, int> collections.

classes.name: MapFieldCopierTests
classes.description: Tests for deep copying MapField<string, int> collections.

classes.name: ByteStringCodecTests
classes.description: Tests for ByteString serialization and equality.

classes.name: ByteStringCopierTests
classes.description: Tests for deep copying ByteString instances.

classes.name: ProtobufGuidExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension method to convert Guid to ByteString.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the serializer builder to include protobuf serializer.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Creates a sample MyProtobufClass instance for testing.

methods.name: TestValues
methods.description: Provides an array of test instances for serialization.

methods.name: ProtobufSerializerDeepCopyTyped
methods.description: Tests deep copying of MyProtobufClass instances via protobuf.

methods.name: ProtobufSerializerDeepCopyUntyped
methods.description: Tests untyped deep copying of MyProtobufClass instances.

methods.name: ProtobufSerializerRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization round trip through codec.

methods.name: ProtobufSerializerRoundTripThroughUntypedSerializer
methods.description: Tests round trip serialization/deserialization via untyped serializer.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality of collections of integers or collections of entries.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Creates sample collection instances for testing, such as RepeatedField and MapField.

methods.name: ToByteString
methods.description: Converts Guid to ByteString extension method.
